``` { .yaml .annotate linenums="1" }
version: '3.2'
services:
  portainer:  # (1)!
    image: portainer/portainer-ee:2.45.1
    command: -H tcp://tasks.agent:9001 --tlsskipverify
    ports:
      - "9443:9443"
      - "9000:9000"
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - data:/data
    networks:
      - portainer
    deploy:
      mode: replicated
      replicas: 1
      placement:
        constraints: [node.role == manager]

networks:
  portainer:
    driver: overlay
    attachable: true

volumes:
  data:
    driver: local
    driver_opts:
      type: none
      device: "/mnt/docker-cephFS/portainer_data"
      o: bind
```

1.  the `-H tcp://tasks.agent:9001` on the `command:` line is left from the stock file, and the server
    cannot resolve that name, since the agents are on another overlay. portainer reads it only when it
    has no environment yet, and each environment here points at an address on 9001.
